o.text: Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish كوزل (gözäl), from Proto-Common Turkic *közäl. Cognate with Turkish güzel, Uzbek goʻzal.

glosses: ball (the set of points in a metric space of distance less than (or equal to) a given number)

o.text: From Arabic كُرَة (kura), ultimately from Sumerian 𒄥 (GUR, “a bundle, rolled up barley”).
From Persian کوره, ultimately from a Semitic source.
Present participle compound of ağır (“heavy”) + tərpən- (“to move”).
